producer_report.summary:
Job G1 is done. `crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs` is now `crates/athena-core/src/gh/mod.rs` (moved with `mv`, no text edited; 5478 lines before and after). `DecisionHeader.paths` for D87 and D88 in `introspect.rs` is now `crates/athena-core/src/gh/`. The `WRAPPER` constant in `tests/external_calls_guard.rs` is now that prefix, compared with `starts_with`. D138 in `docs/decisions.md` is accepted, with the four approvals recorded. `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under [Unreleased] > Changed. I did not run the full `cargo test` (left to Athena's checks); `cargo fmt --all --check` and clippy are clean, and the targeted tests pass.

**`paths` has no matcher.** No code matches `DecisionHeader.paths` against a landing's files: `headers()` is read only for `id`, signals and starts. The new test therefore uses a small test-local helper, `selected_by_path`. An entry ending in `/` covers every file under it; any other entry must match exactly. The test `a_landing_touching_a_file_under_gh_selects_d87_and_d88` checks three things:
- `gh/mod.rs`, `gh/pages.rs` and `gh/land/poll.rs` each select ["D87", "D88"].
- The old file `gh.rs`, the sibling `ghost/mod.rs` and `run.rs` select nothing.
- The test would fail if `paths` still named only `gh.rs`, because `gh/mod.rs` would select nothing.

**Guard changes.** Only the places where the constant is compared changed:
- Line 1 doc comment now names the directory.
- The skip check uses `path.starts_with(WRAPPER)`.
- The "wrapper file present" check uses `starts_with` too, and its message reads "no wrapper file was found".
- The self-test fixture now has two allowed files, `gh/mod.rs` and `gh/sub/part.rs`, both containing a `gh` call, in place of the single `WRAPPER` entry.
- The expected violations list is unchanged: the three outside files still fail and neither `gh/` file is reported.

**Caller check.** Greps run over `crates/` after the rename; the same files and counts were seen before it.
- `gh::|crate::gh|mod gh`: 67 hits in 24 files before, 67 in 24 after. The only path change is `gh.rs:5` to `gh/mod.rs:5`.
- Name grep after: `\b(GhClient|PrHost|land_pr|LandPr|PrReport|Poll|landed_commit|Runner|PagesHost)\b` gives 201 hits in 19 files. Of those, `gh/mod.rs` has 115, `test_support.rs` 12, `external_calls.rs` 20, `display.rs` 10, `reconcile.rs` 6, `pr_check.rs` 6, `trailer_stop.rs` 6, `run_pin_tests.rs` 5, and `run.rs`, `main.rs` 4 each.
- I did not run this name grep on the base tree. Nothing outside the six paths changed, and `gh.rs` was only moved, so the counts are equal by construction, not by a before/after measurement.
- `gh.rs|include_str!|#[path]` over `crates/`: the only `gh.rs` hits were the two `introspect.rs` path literals and the guard's constant and doc comment, now changed. No `#[path]` hit exists. The `include_str!` hits are `athena.toml`, `defaults.toml`, prompts, docs, a self-read of `proposals.rs`/`labeled.rs`, and a study model; none names `gh.rs`.
- No module path changed, so no `use` line needed editing.

**Test counts.** After the change, the `athena-core` lib lists 476 tests (the introspect run showed 12 run plus 464 filtered out) and `external_calls_guard` lists 2. I could not read the saved "before" listing, so I have no baseline count. The only test added is the introspect one; no existing test was edited besides the guard's self-test fixture.

**Left out.** I did not edit `docs/design/structure-pass.md` (the optional "G1 done" pointer). The request's file list and criterion 10 leave it out, even though the expected-deliverables list names it.

mistakes: My first edit to docs/decisions.md deleted the whole D138 Status paragraph, because the old_string spanned the heading and Status. I noticed it on re-reading and restored it with the new accepted Status text.
I did not save a readable baseline of the test names before the change, so the 'before' side of the test list is not independently recorded.
learnings: `DecisionHeader.paths` is data only: nothing in the code matches it against a landing's files. decision-sets.md section 3 says code should select decisions whose `paths` match a deliverable, but that is not implemented.
The producer's Bash cannot run mkdir; to create a new directory I wrote a placeholder file with the Write tool, then used `mv` to replace it.
Output of `cargo test -- --list` is too large to read back, and the persisted tool-result file is outside the working directory, so Grep on it is denied.
The earlier CHANGELOG entry about the structure-pass design still says D138 is recorded as proposed. It is history and was left as written.
desires: Allow mkdir, or let mv create the target directory, so a rename into a new directory does not need a placeholder file.
A way to save the baseline `cargo test -- --list` output inside the working directory, to diff the lists exactly.
